messages:
Jordan Kim: quick follow-up from today's all-hands  can leadership lock down owners + realistic canary windows for API / Console / Optimize? teams need final sprint commitments. :wave:

Aisha Khan: TL;DR owners + targets: API (hosted parity) -> GA target 2026-07-22; Console UX opt-in beta -> 2026-07-08; Optimize (cost tooling + batching hints) -> alpha target 2026-08-20. owners listed below. :point_down:

Liam O'Connor: important: are any of these blocked on Dedicated capacity or telemetry stabilization? we need callouts for contingency planning.

Aisha Khan: short answers: hosted API GA is independent of Dedicated. Optimize alpha requires stable runtime telemetry. Console beta is opt-in and non-breaking.

Nina Park: owners (proposed):
- API GA: Aisha Khan (PM) + Liam O'Connor (Eng lead)
- Console beta: Jordan Kim (Prod) + Nina Park (DevEx)
- Optimize alpha: Raj Patel (ML infra) + Nina Park (Product eng)
I'll create a lightweight checklist doc and weekly 15m sync.

Raj Patel: Optimize alpha will ship initial batching recommendations + a simple quantization suggestion table. full automated profiles are preview-only later. telemetry must provide per-model token counts and per-request latency.

Jordan Kim: canary ask: please publish an example canary plan we can copy into runbooks (traffic ramps, rollback signals, duration).

Liam O'Connor: pasted a minimal canary snippet to copy: 
```
canary_config:
  steps: [1, 5, 20]
  step_duration_days: 3
  total_duration_days: 9
  rollback_if:
    - "5xx_rate > 0.5%"
    - "p95_latency > baseline * 1.25"
    - "user_error_rate_increase > 2%"
```
Use feature flags for Console beta.

Aisha Khan: risks we are watching: perf regressions (adds ~2w), telemetry sampling bug (adds ~3w), and design assets for Console screenshots (depends on design bandwidth). will flag slips in this thread.

Nina Park: checklist fields I'll include: owner, target date, canary window, rollback triggers, docs owner, SDK compatibility notes, partners migration notes. drafting v1 tonight.

Jordan Kim: also request product marketing to draft short release bullets and migration notes for partners. can PMs assign someone?

Aisha Khan: PMs will assign marketing liaisons. expected draft dates: release bullets by 2026-06-18, partner migration notes by 2026-06-25.

Raj Patel: telemetry stabilization ETA today is 2026-06-24 (subject to current sprint). if telemetry slips, Optimize alpha target moves +3w.

Liam O'Connor: action items:
- Nina: checklist doc + owners by 2026-06-10
- Liam: finalize canary plan + health checks by 2026-06-16
- Aisha: tie marketing liaisons + partner notes by 2026-06-25
I'll add calendar invites for the weekly sync. :calendar:

allhands-bot: Recording + slides: https://meet.corp/recordings/2465009800 (follow-up doc will be created) :movie_camera:

Jordan Kim: thanks all. please call out any >10 day slips here so we can re-prioritize. :thumbsup:
